thread.subject: Stockly pilot — week 12 readout
thread.summary: Final 12-store pilot readout to GreenCart Markets; exec team satisfied; expansion to 40 stores agreed conditional on markdown optimizer + Analytos-run onboarding.

messages.body:
Hi Daniel,

Final readout from the 12-store pilot is in. Headlines:

- Fresh-produce waste down 38% vs. your Q4 baseline.
- WMAPE improved from 41% to 22% at SKU-store level.
- Store teams report 9.4 hours/week saved on ordering.
- Stockouts on the top-200 SKUs down 27%.

One number we'd keep between us: your shrink baseline of 6.2% of fresh revenue is what made the 38% swing so large — I'd rather we not quote the 6.2% externally.

Deck attached. Can we grab 30 minutes Thursday to talk expansion?

Priya

Priya,

Numbers landed well with our exec team — the waste reduction alone covers the subscription several times over. Two asks before we sign expansion:

1. Markdown optimizer switched on for the flagship stores.
2. Your team runs onboarding for the next tranche; ours is stretched.

If yes to both, I'm ready to take the pilot from 12 to 40 stores starting July 1st.

Daniel

Done on both. Maya has approved a dedicated onboarding pod for the 28 new stores, and markdown optimizer ships to your flagships next sprint.

Decision confirmed on our side: expand the Stockly pilot from 12 to 40 stores effective July 1, 2026. I'll send the order form today.

Priya
